# Mukovhe Terry Netshivhale

> Mukovhe Terry Netshivhale (also written Mukovhe Netshivhale, Terry Netshivhale, "terrynets") is a BSc Computer Science student at the University of the Witwatersrand (Wits), Johannesburg, South Africa, focused on AI, data engineering and software engineering. He founded Level7Lab, an education and motivation initiative for students, and works on digital media with Quanta Vision Afrika.
